- `internal/filter/http/wasm/decode_headers.go` — per-stream `DecodeHeaders(headers, endStream)` dispatch: constructs `*wasm.VM` via `NewVM(ctx, WithSandboxConfig(cc.sandbox), WithCompilationCache(cc.compileCache.WazeroCompilationCache()))`; registers `ABICallbacks` via `vm.RegisterABICallbacks(abiCallbacksImpl)`; calls `vm.Run(ctx, cc.module, rootContextID=1)`; invokes `vm.CallProxyOnRequestHeaders` if exported; honors PAUSE / captured-local-response / CONTINUE dispositions.
- `internal/filter/http/wasm/encode_headers.go` — per-stream `EncodeHeaders(headers, endStream)` dispatch: invokes `vm.CallProxyOnResponseHeaders` if exported (decode-side `*wasm.VM` reused). Encode-side `executions` Inc REMOVED at the Task 15+17 follow-up (decode-only Inc per AMEND-A2 + SPEC §7 + cross-side fixture-0034 pin).

**3. 5-counter `filterStats` per AMEND-A2 tri-group prefix structure.**

```go
type filterStats struct {
  created         *stats.Counter // wasm.wazero.created   (Group B; NewCounterIfAbsent per ADR-0117)
  active          *stats.Gauge   // wasm.wazero.active    (Group B; NewGaugeIfAbsent)
  executions      *stats.Counter // wasm.<plugin_name>.executions       (envoy-go-strict; decode-only Inc)
  hostcallDenied  *stats.Counter // wasm.<plugin_name>.hostcall_denied  (envoy-go-strict; per ADR-0204)
  envoyGoFailures *stats.Counter // wasm.<plugin_name>.envoy_go.failures (envoy-go-strict)
}
```

Tri-group prefix per AMEND-A2: Group B (shared per-runtime; `wasm.wazero.*`) + envoy-go-strict per-plugin (`wasm.<plugin_name>.*`). HCM-injected `stats_prefix` DROPPED per AMEND-A2 — the wasm filter's stat surface DIVERGES from the dominant §9 family-row HCM-rooted pattern (upstream-parity preservation, NOT envoy-go-strict — recorded as a structural-note row at BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md `## Stat-name mapping` rather than as a departure record). Project stat count 114 → 119 at 25.1 phase-done. `executions` decode-only Inc closure at the Task 15+17 follow-up: encode-side Inc was the bug per the AMEND-A2 + SPEC §7 line 738 + §5.1 hostcall 1 commentary + §4.3 line 787 + the cross-side fixture-0034 scenario-(e) pin. NEW SN9 Prometheus flattening rule landed at `internal/stats/name.go::flattenToProm` at the same follow-up: `case strings.HasPrefix(internal, "wasm.")` arm — NO label promotion; `<scope>` INLINED; internal dots in `<rest>` converted to `_`. Projection: `wasm.wazero.created` → `envoy_wasm_wazero_created`; `wasm.plugin_e.executions` → `envoy_wasm_plugin_e_executions`; `wasm.plugin_e.envoy_go.failures` → `envoy_wasm_plugin_e_envoy_go_failures`.

**4. 24-hostcall + 13-callback bridge surface wiring (per §5).**

Per-stream dispatch: at `DecodeHeaders` the filter constructs a fresh `internal/wasm/VM` via `NewVM(ctx, WithSandboxConfig(cc.sandbox), WithCompilationCache(cc.compileCache.WazeroCompilationCache()))`; registers the 10-method `ABICallbacks` bundle via `vm.RegisterABICallbacks(abiCallbacksImpl)`; calls `vm.Run(ctx, cc.module, rootContextID=1)` which executes (a) wazero re-compile against vm.runtime (sub-ms hit via shared CompilationCache) + (b) Instantiate + (c) `_initialize` OR `_start` + (c.5) `proxy_on_context_create(1, 0)` + (d) `proxy_on_vm_start(1, 0)` + (e) `proxy_on_configure(1, 0)`. Then `vm.CallProxyOnRequestHeaders(ctx, streamCtxID, numHeaders, endOfStream) → ProxyAction`. PAUSE-return (=1) without prior `proxy_send_local_response` invocation is treated as CONTINUE per the v1.37.2 binding-gap `allow_on_headers_stop_iteration` field (DEFERRED to 25.2). Encode-side mirrors decode for `proxy_on_response_headers`. `OnDestroy` calls `vm.Close()` releasing the wazero Runtime.

**D-P3 closure at Task 11 — ADR-0196 first co-consumer.** The `proxy_get_status` hostcall (host returns the HTTP response status code to the guest) requires read-access to the encode-side status code; the phase-23 admission_control filter introduced the `EncoderFilterCallbacks.ResponseStatus() int` accessor (ADR-0196 — root-cause fix for phase-23 PD-5's INVALID `:status`-via-header assumption surfaced by differential fixture 0030). The 25.1 wasm filter is the FIRST CO-CONSUMER of ADR-0196 — RATIFIES the phase-23 framework-primitive extraction discipline (the accessor exists at the framework callbacks layer, not at the per-filter layer, so multi-consumer reuse works). PROGRESS Task 11 quotes the ADR-0196 + encoder-callback shape evidence; encoder-callback contract: encode-side `ResponseStatus()` returns the set-once status code per the HCM dispatch protocol.

The `internal/filter/http/wasm/datasource.go::resolveDataSource` helper resolves `core.DataSource` to bytes at config-load time (NOT per-request — the resolved bytes feed into the per-`*compiledConfig` cached `*wasm.Module` via `internal/wasm/CompileModule`). The 4 active arms: (1) `Filename` → `os.ReadFile`; (2) `InlineBytes` → verbatim; (3) `InlineString` → byte-cast; (4) `EnvironmentVariable` → `os.LookupEnv`. `WatchedDirectory` PARSE-REJECTs (arm 5) — deferred to future Runtime/hot-reload phase. AsyncDataSource `Remote` arm PARSE-REJECTs (arm 6) — envoy-go-strict departure per BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md record #3.

### Consequences

- **(+) Standard §9 HTTP-filter package shape at the EIGHTEENTH and FINAL §9 family-row.** The `internal/filter/http/wasm/` package follows the proven §9 family-row template (filter struct + factory + parse + 4-arm DataSource + per-stream callbacks + stats + per-route stub) — closes the §9 HTTP-filters family at 0 remaining rows after phase 25 phase-done.
- **(+) 18-arm PARSE-REJECT roster with D-P5 byte-stable wording protects operators from undefined behavior.** 18 byte-pinned constants form the full PARSE-REJECT vocabulary at 25.1 phase-done; any future config-shape evolution surfaces a recognizable PARSE-REJECT message (not silent dispatch into unimplemented hostcalls). Arms 6 + 11 anchor the 2 envoy-go-strict departures consolidated into BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md record #3.
- **(+) ADR-0196 first co-consumer RATIFIES the phase-23 framework-primitive extraction discipline.** The `EncoderFilterCallbacks.ResponseStatus()` accessor exists at the framework callbacks layer (not at the per-filter layer); the 25.1 wasm filter's `proxy_get_status` hostcall consumes it WITHOUT modifying the framework — first-of-kind validation of the phase-23 extraction shape.
- **(+) 5-counter envoy-go-strict-augmented stat surface provides operator observability into the wasm dispatch path.** The 2 upstream-parity counters (`wasm.wazero.created` + `wasm.wazero.active`) provide VM lifecycle observability; the 3 envoy-go-strict counters provide per-plugin invocation rate + sandbox-denial rate + failure-event rate. Tri-group prefix structure per AMEND-A2 + the NEW SN9 wasm-flattening rule at `internal/stats/name.go` enables Prometheus rendering as `envoy_wasm_<runtime>_<stat>` (Group B) + `envoy_wasm_<plugin>_<stat>` (Group C).
- **(+) Cross-side fixture-0034 with 7 scenarios provides comprehensive per-hostcall byte-exact validation.** 4 wasm plugins × 7 scenarios cover header_mutation + send_local_response + log_only + property_access surfaces; vendored Rust-sourced bytecode is committed under git for reproducibility without CI Rust toolchain.
- **(+) D-S1 RATIFIED + 34th project-wide fuzzer clean at 30s/seed.** `FuzzWasmConfigParse` lands clean at 3M+ execs / 67 new interesting / no panics per ADR-0018 fuzzer discipline. The 18-arm PARSE-REJECT roster + the 4-arm DataSource roster are fuzzer-validated.
- **(-) HCM-injected `stats_prefix` DROPPED structural divergence from §9 family-row pattern.** The wasm filter's stat surface uses `wasm.wazero.*` + `wasm.<plugin_name>.*` (not `http.<HCM_stat_prefix>.wasm.*`) — DIVERGES from the dominant §9 family-row HCM-rooted pattern (fault / csrf / compressor / rbac / jwt_authn / ext_authz / ext_proc / oauth2 / adaptive_concurrency / lua / admission_control). Upstream-parity preservation NOT envoy-go-strict (upstream `source/extensions/filters/http/wasm/config.h:51-53` drops the HCM stats_prefix); recorded as a structural-note row at BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md. Operators dashboarding wasm-filter stats use the standalone `wasm.*` scope rather than the HCM-rooted scope they may be familiar with from other §9 family rows.
- **(-) Per-route surface DEFERRED to 25.3 + REUSE-by-absence anticipated.** At 25.1 `WasmPerRoute` PARSE-REJECTs at boot-level (the v1.37.2 proto has no per-route message; any TPFC entry under the wasm filter PARSE-REJECTs at HCM-parse-time via the existing ADR-0110 single-chokepoint). 25.3 settles whether to STAY at PARSE-REJECT-by-absence (anticipated YES per AMEND-A3 ABSENCE-DEFINITIVE) OR introduce a NEW 11th canonical (low probability — only if SPEC scrape SURFACES a novel-shape proto).
- **(-) Vendored Rust-sourced bytecode introduces an out-of-band toolchain dependency for fixture-0034.** The `bytecode/` subdirectory carries pre-built wasm files; CI runs the differential without recompiling. Operators / contributors who want to extend the fixture-0034 plugins need the Rust toolchain (`rustc 1.78+` per AMEND-A1 + the `wasm32-wasip1` target) — documented at `scripts/README.md`. Mitigated: 25.1's 4 plugins cover the headers-bridge surface comprehensively; bytecode changes are rare.
- **(?) `proxy_get_status` hostcall semantic uncertainty at the encode-side decode-side boundary.** The `proxy_get_status` hostcall fires from the guest's `proxy_on_response_headers` callback; envoy-go's encode-side `ResponseStatus()` accessor returns the set-once status code from HCM dispatch. If the guest invokes `proxy_get_status` from `proxy_on_request_headers` (before the status is set), the accessor returns 0; the hostcall returns `WasmResult::NotFound`=1 to the guest. Documented for future Lua-style test scripts that may exercise the boundary; not yet stress-tested.
- **(?) Forward-pointer: 25.2 advanced-bridge surface delta** (per parent §10 + phase-25.1 SPEC §2.11) — body+buffer + trailers + timer + metrics + shared-data + httpCall + foreign-function + full stream-info land at 25.2. Likely +4 envoy-go-strict counters (`tick_invocations` + `http_call_dispatched` + `http_call_response` + `foreign_function_denied`); project total advances 119 → ~123 at 25.2 phase-done.

## ADR-0204: proxy-wasm capability-restriction default-deny + envoy-go-strict sandbox posture — empty `allowed_capabilities` ⇒ DENY-ALL (departure from upstream allow-all per parent SPEC AMEND-A5) + capability key roster (~80 keys; 25.1 covers 24 hostcall keys + 13 module-getter callbacks) + denial semantic (`WasmResult::InternalFailure` + integration error log + `hostcall_denied` counter increment) + accept-empty-SanitizationConfig discipline per parent SPEC AMEND-A1 §11.4 + BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT departure record

**Status:** §Context anchored at phase-25 parent SPEC commit (this commit); §Decision + §Consequences body lands at phase-25.1 IMPL Lands-in-Task at sandbox-config materialization (paired with ADR-0202 + ADR-0203).
**Date:** 2026-05-24
**Doctrine:** Phase 25 §9 family-row. ADR-0044 ADR-on-impl convention + §Context-draft discipline.
**Lands-in:** Phase 25.1 IMPL Lands-in-Task at `internal/wasm/sandbox.go` materialization.

### Context

ADR-0204 anchors the envoy-go-strict default-deny capability sandbox posture for the wasm filter row. Per phase-25 BRAINSTORM Q4 + parent SPEC §2.5 + §4.3 + §11.4 D7 empirical scrape + AMEND-A5.

**Upstream Envoy v1.37.2 default-allow gate** per `proxy-wasm/proxy-wasm-cpp-host@main:include/proxy-wasm/wasm.h:103-106` (the `capabilityAllowed` gate function):

```cpp
bool capabilityAllowed(std::string capability_name) {
  return allowed_capabilities_.empty() ||
         allowed_capabilities_.find(capability_name) != allowed_capabilities_.end();
}
```

When `allowed_capabilities_` is empty (the default — also the result of unset `capability_restriction_config` OR its `allowed_capabilities` map empty), ALL hostcalls ALLOWED. Map non-empty → only capabilities whose names appear as keys are allowed; all others denied with `WasmResult::InternalFailure` (=10) + integration error log per `proxy_wasm_exports.h:217-226`.

**envoy-go-strict departure: invert empty-map semantic to DENY-ALL.** Operators MUST explicitly enable each capability via `PluginConfig.capability_restriction_config.allowed_capabilities[<capability_name>] = SanitizationConfig{}`. Rationale: WASM has a substantially larger and riskier hostcall surface than Lua (proxy_call_foreign_function for arbitrary host-side dispatch; proxy_dispatch_http_call for outbound network; proxy_set_shared_data for cross-stream state; proxy_define_metric for unbounded dynamic-stat namespace creation); upstream Envoy v1.37.2 marks its 3 sandbox runtimes (V8, WAMR, Wasmtime) as `status: alpha` + `security_posture: unknown` (per `source/extensions/extensions_metadata.yaml:1631-1635`) — the alpha-status posture is incompatible with envoy-go's safe-by-default discipline. Matches phase-22 lua's default-deny `SandboxConfig` posture (ADR-0188) at the analogous semantic + the project's security-first defaults pattern.

**Capability key roster (~80 keys).** Per §11.4 D7 scrape:
- **Core hostcalls (37 keys):** `proxy_log`, `proxy_get_status`, `proxy_set_property`, `proxy_get_property`, `proxy_send_local_response`, `proxy_get_shared_data`, `proxy_set_shared_data`, `proxy_register_shared_queue`, `proxy_resolve_shared_queue`, `proxy_dequeue_shared_queue`, `proxy_enqueue_shared_queue`, `proxy_get_header_map_value`, `proxy_add_header_map_value`, `proxy_replace_header_map_value`, `proxy_remove_header_map_value`, `proxy_get_header_map_pairs`, `proxy_set_header_map_pairs`, `proxy_get_header_map_size`, `proxy_get_buffer_status`, `proxy_get_buffer_bytes`, `proxy_set_buffer_bytes`, `proxy_http_call`, `proxy_grpc_call`, `proxy_grpc_stream`, `proxy_grpc_close`, `proxy_grpc_cancel`, `proxy_grpc_send`, `proxy_set_tick_period_milliseconds`, `proxy_get_current_time_nanoseconds`, `proxy_define_metric`, `proxy_increment_metric`, `proxy_record_metric`, `proxy_get_metric`, `proxy_set_effective_context`, `proxy_done`, `proxy_call_foreign_function`, `proxy_get_log_level`.
- **ABI-versioned hostcalls (7 keys):** `proxy_continue_stream` (v0.2.0/v0.2.1), `proxy_close_stream` (v0.2.0/v0.2.1), `proxy_get_log_level` (v0.2.1 only) — plus v0.1.0-only `proxy_get_configuration`, `proxy_continue_request`, `proxy_continue_response`, `proxy_clear_route_cache` (envoy-go PARSE-REJECTs v0.1.0 modules per AMEND-A6 + §6.2 arm 16 so these keys never reach the gate at envoy-go).
- **WASI hostcalls (bare names, no `proxy_` prefix; 12 implemented keys):** `fd_write`, `fd_read`, `fd_seek`, `fd_close`, `fd_fdstat_get`, `environ_get`, `environ_sizes_get`, `args_get`, `args_sizes_get`, `proc_exit`, `clock_time_get`, `random_get`. Other ~30 WASI keys exist but are stubbed to return `WasiErrno::ENOTCAPABLE` regardless of configuration.
- **Module-function getter keys (24 keys; gated at `getFunction` lookup side):** `proxy_validate_configuration`, `proxy_on_vm_start`, `proxy_on_configure`, `proxy_on_tick`, `proxy_on_context_create`, `proxy_on_new_connection`, `proxy_on_downstream_data`, `proxy_on_upstream_data`, `proxy_on_downstream_connection_close`, `proxy_on_upstream_connection_close`, `proxy_on_request_body`, `proxy_on_request_trailers`, `proxy_on_request_metadata`, `proxy_on_response_body`, `proxy_on_response_trailers`, `proxy_on_response_metadata`, `proxy_on_http_call_response`, `proxy_on_grpc_receive`, `proxy_on_grpc_close`, `proxy_on_grpc_receive_initial_metadata`, `proxy_on_grpc_receive_trailing_metadata`, `proxy_on_queue_ready`, `proxy_on_done`, `proxy_on_log`, `proxy_on_delete` — plus ABI-versioned `proxy_on_request_headers` (v0.1 vs v0.2 variants) + `proxy_on_response_headers` + `proxy_on_foreign_function` (v0.2.0+).

**25.1 closed-world capability subset (24 hostcall keys + 13 module-getter callback keys).** Per parent SPEC §4.3.4. 25.1 envoy-go-strict gate accepts only the listed 24+13 = 37 keys; configs naming keys outside the closed-world set fail validation (TBD-25.1-IMPL: settle whether the unknown-key validation is PARSE-REJECT at config-load OR silent no-op matching upstream's silent-ignore-of-unimplemented-keys per `proxy-wasm-cpp-host:wasm.cc:248-249` — the gate function itself is silent-ignore; PARSE-REJECT at config-load is the envoy-go-strict-stricter alternative).

**Denial semantic** per `proxy-wasm-cpp-host:proxy_wasm_exports.h:217-226`:

```cpp
return Word(WasmResult::InternalFailure);  // returns InternalFailure (=10) to the guest
context->wasmVm()->integration()->error("Attempted call to restricted proxy-wasm capability: proxy_" #_fn);  // logs an integration error
```

envoy-go MUST mirror upstream byte-faithfully: return `WasmResult::InternalFailure` (=10) + emit an integration error log via `slog.Error("Attempted call to restricted proxy-wasm capability: <name>")` + increment the `wasm.<plugin_name>.hostcall_denied` envoy-go-strict counter per ADR-0203 + AMEND-A2. WASI denials use a separate stub returning `WasiErrno::ENOTCAPABLE` (=76) per `proxy_wasm_exports.h:232-249` — TBD-25.1-IMPL per parent SPEC D-P1: settle whether to mirror `ENOTCAPABLE` exactly OR fall back to `NOTSUP` (=58) if wazero's WASI semantics prevent the exact upstream return code (envoy-go-strict departure if fallback fires).

**Accept-empty-SanitizationConfig discipline** per parent SPEC AMEND-A1 §11.4. Upstream's `SanitizationConfig` proto is EMPTY (no fields) + upstream marks the per-capability sanitization layer "currently unimplemented and ignored, and so should be left empty" (`source/extensions/common/wasm/plugin.cc:14`). envoy-go matches upstream byte-faithfully — accept empty `SanitizationConfig{}` values (parse-and-discard non-empty mirrors phase-24's `override_option` INERT acceptance per ADR-0199 AMEND-4). NO PARSE-REJECT on non-empty SanitizationConfig; NO IMPL surface beyond the accept-empty discipline.

**envoy-go-strict departure record at BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md** per parent SPEC §13 edit #3. One of 4-5 envoy-go-strict departure records at the 25.1 IMPL final Task bundle.

### Decision

The 25.1 IMPL anchors the default-deny capability sandbox posture at `internal/wasm/sandbox.go` per AMEND-A5 + the §11.4 D7 empirical scrape + the §3.3 + 37-key materialized roster at 25.1. The denial semantic mirrors upstream byte-faithfully WHILE INVERTING the empty-map default. Landed at IMPL Task 6 (`sandbox.go` materialization + 37-key roster + `IsAllowed(capabilityName string) bool` contract + D-P2 closure) + Task 7 (`registration.go` wiring of the 8 lifecycle / HTTP-phase + 24 hostcall keys through the `IsAllowed` gate) + Task 11 (`abi_callbacks.go` `hostcall_denied` counter Inc on denied paths) + Task 17 (BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md departure record #1 atomic landing).

**1. `SandboxConfig` zero-value `StrictDefaultDeny` posture (per AMEND-A5).**

```go
// internal/wasm/sandbox.go
type SandboxConfig struct {
    // allowed is the set of allow-listed capability keys. Zero-value (nil) =
    // DENY-ALL per AMEND-A5 envoy-go-strict departure from upstream allow-all.
    // Populated via NewSandboxConfig(allowedCapabilities map[string]SanitizationConfig).
    allowed map[string]struct{}
}

func (sb SandboxConfig) IsAllowed(capabilityName string) bool {
    if sb.allowed == nil {
        return false // DENY-ALL (zero-value); operators MUST opt in
    }
    _, ok := sb.allowed[capabilityName]
    return ok
}
```

INVERSION from upstream `proxy-wasm-cpp-host:include/proxy-wasm/wasm.h:103-106` `capabilityAllowed` gate (which returns true when `allowed_capabilities_.empty()`). Operators MUST explicitly enable each capability via `PluginConfig.capability_restriction_config.allowed_capabilities[<capability_name>] = SanitizationConfig{}`. `NewSandboxConfig(allowedCapabilities map[string]SanitizationConfig) SandboxConfig` populates the `allowed` set from the operator-supplied map (the `SanitizationConfig` value is parsed-and-discarded per the accept-empty discipline below).

**2. 37-key materialized capability roster at 25.1 (per §3.3 + 25.1 SPEC §3.3).**

- **8 lifecycle / HTTP-phase callback keys** (sandbox-gated at `internal/wasm/vm.go::CallProxyOnX` per upstream `wasm.cc:181-206` `_GET_PROXY` macro discipline):
  - `capProxyOnVmStart` (gates step (d) of `vm.Run` lifecycle)
  - `capProxyOnConfigure` (gates step (e) of `vm.Run`)
  - `capProxyOnContextCreate` (gates step (c.5) of `vm.Run` + `CallProxyOnContextCreate`)
  - `capProxyOnRequestHeaders` (gates `CallProxyOnRequestHeaders`)
  - `capProxyOnResponseHeaders` (gates `CallProxyOnResponseHeaders`)
  - `capProxyOnDone` (gates `CallProxyOnDone`)
  - `capProxyOnLog` (gates `CallProxyOnLog`)
  - `capProxyOnDelete` (gates `CallProxyOnDelete`)
- **24 hostcall keys** (16 `proxy_*` env-namespace + 8 `wasi_*` namespace; sandbox-gated at `internal/wasm/registration.go` per upstream `proxy_wasm_exports.h:217-226`): see the 24-hostcall roster at ADR-0203 §Decision section 4.
- **5 module-init / allocator keys** (UNGATED per D-P2 closure at Task 6): `_initialize` / `_start` / `main` / `malloc` / `proxy_on_memory_allocate`. `vm.Run` invokes `_initialize` OR `_start` directly without checking `IsAllowed`.

**D-P2 closure at Task 6.** Empirically scraped upstream `proxy-wasm-cpp-host:wasm.cc:298-302` `Wasm::initializeFunctions` + the `_GET_FUNCTION` macro. The 5 module-init / allocator callbacks are UNGATED regardless of the sandbox map contents — they are required for ANY wasm guest to bootstrap (allocator + entry-point); gating them would prevent the guest from ever calling sandbox-allowed hostcalls. The 8 lifecycle / HTTP-phase callbacks ARE sandbox-gated via the `_GET_PROXY` macro (`wasm.cc:181-206`).

**3. Denial semantic per upstream `proxy_wasm_exports.h:217-226` (byte-faithful for hostcalls; bidirectional for WASI).**

For sandbox-denied **hostcalls** (proxy_*):

```cpp
// upstream proxy_wasm_exports.h:217-226 — envoy-go mirrors byte-faithfully
return Word(WasmResult::InternalFailure);  // returns InternalFailure (=10) to the guest
context->wasmVm()->integration()->error("Attempted call to restricted proxy-wasm capability: proxy_" #_fn);
```

envoy-go-side at `internal/filter/http/wasm/abi_callbacks.go`:

```go
if !cb.vm.IsAllowed(capKey) {
    if cb.stats != nil { cb.stats.hostcallDenied.Inc() }
    slog.Error("Attempted call to restricted proxy-wasm capability: " + capKey)
    return abi.WasmResultInternalFailure // = 10
}
```

The 3-component denial protocol: (a) return `WasmResult::InternalFailure` (=10) to the guest; (b) emit an integration error log via `slog.Error("Attempted call to restricted proxy-wasm capability: <name>")` (matches upstream's `integration->error` log shape; envoy-go uses `slog.Error` per the project's slog discipline); (c) increment the `wasm.<plugin_name>.hostcall_denied` envoy-go-strict counter per ADR-0203 + AMEND-A2.

For sandbox-denied **WASI hostcalls** (wasi_*): return `WasiErrno::ENOTCAPABLE` = 76 per D-P1 closure at Task 2. envoy-go's `internal/wasm/wasi.go` 8-stub returns this errno byte-faithfully for any denied WASI key.

**D-P1 closure at Task 2.** Empirically scraped upstream `proxy-wasm-cpp-host:proxy_wasm_exports.h:232-249` — `WasiErrno::ENOTCAPABLE`=76 is the canonical denied-capability errno for WASI hostcalls. envoy-go matches upstream byte-faithfully; no fallback to `NOTSUP`=58 (the speculative SPEC fallback per D-P1 hypothesis); ENOTCAPABLE is wazero-compatible.

For sandbox-denied **lifecycle / HTTP-phase callbacks** (proxy_on_*): the per-callback `CallProxyOnX` method SKIPS the call entirely (treats as if the guest didn't export the function — matches upstream's "nullptr the function pointer" discipline). The HTTP-phase callbacks (request_headers + response_headers) return `ProxyActionContinue` (=0) + nil error on the skip path — request flows continue unmolested. The lifecycle callbacks return nil on the skip path — no-op success.

**4. `SanitizationConfig` accept-empty discipline (per AMEND-A1 §11.4).**

Upstream's `SanitizationConfig` proto is EMPTY (no fields) + upstream marks the per-capability sanitization layer "currently unimplemented and ignored, and so should be left empty" (`source/extensions/common/wasm/plugin.cc:14`). envoy-go matches upstream byte-faithfully — accept empty `SanitizationConfig{}` values (parse-and-discard non-empty mirrors phase-24's `override_option` INERT acceptance per ADR-0199 AMEND-4). NO PARSE-REJECT on non-empty SanitizationConfig; NO IMPL surface beyond the accept-empty discipline. The future activation of per-capability sanitization (if/when upstream lands a non-empty SanitizationConfig schema) lands at a future phase — for now the SanitizationConfig is a value-stub at the map's value position.

**5. Closed-world capability subset disposition at 25.1.**

The 25.1 closed-world subset is 37 keys (8 + 24 + 5). Configs naming keys OUTSIDE this closed-world set are SILENT-IGNORED at the sandbox `IsAllowed` gate (the unknown key's lookup returns false → DENY on the hostcall path; the lookup is silent — no PARSE-REJECT at config-load). This matches upstream's silent-ignore-of-unimplemented-keys posture per `proxy-wasm-cpp-host:wasm.cc:248-249`. **TBD-IMPL deferral lifted at Task 6**: settled as SILENT-IGNORE (matches upstream). Operators using future-roster keys (proxy_set_tick_period_milliseconds / proxy_define_metric / etc. — DEFERRED at 25.1 stub-Unimplemented per parent §4.2 Option B) observe the DENY-by-default behavior because their unknown-key allowance has no effect — the hostcall itself returns `WasmResult::Unimplemented` (=12) via the stub-Unimplemented dispatch, NOT `WasmResult::InternalFailure` (=10). The two return values are operationally distinct: `Unimplemented` = "the host doesn't implement this yet"; `InternalFailure` = "the host implements it but the sandbox denies it".

**6. envoy-go-strict departure record #1 at BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md (per parent SPEC §13 edit #3 + this ADR-0204).**

Landed at the 25.1 IMPL Task 17 atomic landing per ADR-0052 atomic-record discipline. The departure record cites the WASM-vs-Lua hostcall-surface-risk rationale (WASM's `proxy_call_foreign_function` + `proxy_dispatch_http_call` + `proxy_set_shared_data` + `proxy_define_metric` surface substantially exceeds Lua's bridge surface in operator-side reach), the upstream alpha-status posture of the 3 sandbox runtimes (V8 / WAMR / Wasmtime — `source/extensions/extensions_metadata.yaml:1631-1635` marks each `status: alpha` + `security_posture: unknown`), + cross-references to ADR-0188 (phase-22 lua's analogous default-deny `SandboxConfig` posture).

### Consequences

- **(+) Eliminates accidental privilege escalation at the proxy-wasm capability layer.** Operators MUST explicitly opt into each capability — silent broadening requires an operator-visible config edit. Matches the project's security-first defaults pattern (phase-04 TLS strict-by-default + phase-10 header_mutation pre-mutation-allowlist + phase-22 lua default-deny SandboxConfig). The 37-key materialized roster + the byte-faithful upstream-mirroring denial protocol ensure operators can adopt the upstream hostcall vocabulary without surprise behavior changes (the only behavior change is the default-deny inversion; the per-capability semantics are unchanged).
- **(+) Observable denial signal via the `hostcall_denied` envoy-go-strict counter.** Operators dashboarding `wasm.<plugin_name>.hostcall_denied` see immediate signal when a wasm plugin attempts a non-allowed hostcall — enables operator-side "this plugin needs additional capabilities" diagnosis. Paired with the integration error log (`slog.Error("Attempted call to restricted proxy-wasm capability: <name>")`) which carries the specific capability name for log-line aggregation.
- **(+) D-P1 closure: `WasiErrno::ENOTCAPABLE`=76 matches upstream byte-faithfully.** No envoy-go-strict departure on the WASI denial side; upstream-parity preservation. Guests written against the upstream proxy-wasm-rust-sdk + similar SDKs behave identically against envoy-go's WASI denial path.
- **(+) D-P2 closure: 5 module-init / allocator UNGATED matches upstream byte-faithfully.** No envoy-go-strict departure on the module-bootstrap side; guests can bootstrap (allocator + entry-point) regardless of the sandbox config. Sandbox-gating these would prevent ALL wasm execution (operators couldn't even enable any hostcall — the module wouldn't bootstrap).
- **(+) `SanitizationConfig` accept-empty discipline matches upstream byte-faithfully.** No PARSE-REJECT on `SanitizationConfig{}` values; no IMPL surface beyond the accept-empty discipline. Future SanitizationConfig schema activation lands at a future phase.
- **(-) Operators must explicitly opt into every capability — substantially higher operator burden than the upstream allow-all default.** The "deny-by-default" posture means a wasm plugin authored against the upstream allow-all default WILL fail-to-execute under envoy-go-strict until the operator populates the `allowed_capabilities` map. Mitigated: the BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md departure record #1 + the integration error log + the `hostcall_denied` counter provide three observable signals for diagnosis. The operator pain is intentional + matches the project's security-first defaults.
- **(-) Silent-ignore of unknown keys is operator-friendlier than PARSE-REJECT but loses the boot-time-fail-fast property.** A typo in a capability key (e.g., `proxy_get_header_map_pairss` with extra `s`) silently denies the legitimate `proxy_get_header_map_pairs` hostcall — the operator sees the denial via the `hostcall_denied` counter + the integration error log, but not at boot time. Mitigated: matches upstream byte-faithfully (silent-ignore is upstream's posture); a future operator-tooling pass could add a `wasm-config-validate` linter that PARSE-REJECTs typos against the closed-world 37-key roster.
- **(-) Closed-world 37-key roster requires expansion at 25.2 + 25.3 as deferred hostcalls land.** 25.2's body+buffer + advanced bridge surface adds ~10-15 new capability keys (`proxy_get_buffer_*` + `proxy_set_tick_*` + `proxy_define_metric` + ...); 25.3's per-route + multi-plugin surface adds 0-2 keys (no new hostcalls expected). The roster grows alongside the hostcall surface; each new key surfaces as a roster amendment with PROGRESS.md documentation.
- **(?) Departure rationale carries explicit "WASM is riskier than Lua" framing.** The BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md record #1 cites the WASM-vs-Lua hostcall-surface-risk explicitly + the upstream alpha-status posture of the 3 sandbox runtimes. Operators who want to operate with upstream-parity allow-all semantics MUST explicitly populate the allowed_capabilities map with every key they need; envoy-go does NOT expose an "allow-all" shortcut (e.g., a `_default_allow_all: true` boolean) because that would defeat the security-first defaults discipline. Forward-pointed for 25.2 if operator-feedback surfaces friction.

**Cross-references:** ADR-0202 (paired primitive-side ADR — `internal/wasm/` framework primitive; `SandboxConfig` lives at `internal/wasm/sandbox.go`); ADR-0203 (paired HTTP-filter-package ADR; the `hostcall_denied` counter lives at `internal/filter/http/wasm/stats.go`); ADR-0125 (per-route canonical patterns — 5th-canonical REUSE-by-absence per AMEND-A3); phase-25 parent SPEC §2.5 + §4.3 + §11.4 D7 + §1.1 AMEND-A5; phase-22.1 ADR-0188 §Decision body (the prior default-deny `SandboxConfig` precedent — different runtime + different stdlib roster but identical strict-by-default rationale); phase-04 TLS strict-by-default precedent; phase-10 header_mutation pre-mutation-allowlist precedent.

## ADR-0205: Root VM lifecycle evolution at 25.2 — ONE long-lived `*RootVM` per `*compiledConfig` (upstream-byte-faithful per cpp-host `Wasm`/`Plugin` model); per-stream contexts as CHILDREN sharing wazero Runtime+Module; per-`*RootVM` tick goroutine + 10ms envoy-go-strict period floor + Clock seam FIRST co-consumer beyond phase-21; shared-data + httpCall + foreign-function-registry state at root; per-stream Module instantiation pattern (fresh vs pooled vs shared) deferred to 25.2 IMPL R8 escape-valve at the > 1ms threshold (D-25.2-P2 + parent §13-R8)

**Status:** Accepted; §Context anchored at phase-25.2 SPEC commit; §Decision + §Consequences body landed at phase-25.2 IMPL Task 1 + ratified at IMPL Task 22 atomic landing per ADR-0044 in-place edit discipline. R8 disposition: STANDS WEAK-default at Task 22 (`BenchmarkPerStreamModule_Instantiation = ~98 ns/op` << 1ms threshold); ADR-0209 escape-valve STAYS UNCONSUMED + carries forward to 25.3 IMPL. **AMENDED 2026-05-29 per phase-25.3 IMPL Task 15** — the `*RootVM per *compiledConfig` anchor is REFINED to per-`(vm_id, vm_configuration, code)` shared `*RootVM` via the registry (see §Consequences AMEND below + ADR-0211).
**Date:** 2026-05-25 (§Context anchor at 25.2 SPEC commit); 2026-05-26 (§Decision + §Consequences body landed at 25.2 IMPL Task 22 atomic landing); 2026-05-29 (§Consequences AMEND at 25.3 IMPL Task 15).
**Doctrine:** Phase 25.2 §9 family-row sub-phase. ADR-0044 ADR-on-impl convention + §Context-draft discipline + Q10 strict-scope precedent from phase-22.2 (consumer-#1-internal-scope API evolution lands under NEW ADRs rather than amending ADR-0202's §Decision body).
**Lands-in:** Phase 25.2 IMPL first task that materializes `internal/wasm/root_vm.go` (anticipated Task 1 per the phase-25.1 + phase-22.1 framework-primitive-first-task precedent).

### Context

ADR-0205 anchors the **root VM lifecycle evolution at 25.2** per phase-25.2 BRAINSTORM Q3 + 25.2 SPEC §3.1. The 25.1 IMPL landed a per-stream `*VM` model (each `DecodeHeaders` invocation constructed a fresh `*wazero.Runtime` at `~61µs/stream` per the 25.1 Task 17 R8 benchmark; well under threshold but not the upstream-byte-faithful shape). 25.2 EVOLVES the model to **ONE long-lived `*RootVM` per `*compiledConfig`** with **per-stream contexts as CHILDREN** sharing the root VM's wazero Runtime + Module — upstream-byte-faithful per proxy-wasm-cpp-host's `Wasm` / `Plugin` model where the per-stream context is allocated via `proxy_on_context_create(stream_ctx_id, root_ctx_id)` on the shared Module instance (NOT via Runtime construction).

**Root VM trigger per Q3 + Q10 strict-scope.** The 25.2 IMPL EVOLVES the `internal/wasm/` framework primitive (ADR-0202) under a NEW ADR per Q10 strict-scope precedent from phase-22.2 (the analogous decision for `internal/lua/` evolution at 22.2 — phase-22.2 ADR-0190 + ADR-0191 + ADR-0192 anchored 22.2 consumer-#1-internal evolutions while ADR-0188 stayed scoped to consumer-#2 future revisions). ADR-0202's API-REVISION ALLOWANCE clause STAYS scoped to consumer #2 (broader §9 WASM host family); the 25.2 consumer-#1-internal-scope evolutions land under ADR-0205 + ADR-0206 + ADR-0207 + ADR-0208. ADR-0202 gains a one-line in-place AMEND acknowledgment paragraph in §Consequences per 25.2 SPEC §10.2 (no new ADR number consumed for the acknowledgment).

**Root VM lifecycle shape.** The `*RootVM` owns: (a) the wazero Runtime + compiled Module instance (single per RootVM); (b) the tick goroutine + tick state (per Q5 + ADR-0186 Clock seam); (c) the shared-data map + sync.RWMutex + envoy-go-strict caps (per Q6 + AMEND-A5); (d) the httpCall response routing state (call_id allocation + per-call pending state + cancel-at-destruction discipline per AMEND-B3); (e) the foreign-function registry view (pointer to `wasm.DefaultForeignFunctionRegistry` by default; testable seam per AMEND-A9); (f) the per-plugin dynamic-stats Registry (per Q9 + AMEND-B2); (g) the per-stream-context map (`streamCtxID → *StreamContext`). Constructed at config-load via `NewRootVM(ctx, module, rootCtxID, opts...)` + `Configure(ctx, vmConfigBytes, pluginConfigBytes)` (fires `_initialize` OR `_start` + `proxy_on_vm_start` + `proxy_on_configure` ONCE on the root context). Persists for plugin lifetime; closed at `*compiledConfig` shutdown via `Close()` (stops tick goroutine + cancels in-flight httpCalls + closes the dynamic-stats Registry + releases the wazero Runtime).

**Per-stream `*StreamContext` REPLACES 25.1 per-stream `*VM`.** Each `DecodeHeaders` entry calls `rootVM.NewStreamContext(ctx)` which allocates a `streamCtxID` (monotonic counter per `*RootVM`) + invokes `proxy_on_context_create(streamCtxID, rootCtxID)` on the shared Module instance + returns a `*StreamContext` handle. The per-stream `*StreamContext` exposes the same callable methods as 25.1's per-stream `*VM` (CallProxyOnRequestHeaders + CallProxyOnResponseHeaders + ...) plus 7 NEW methods for the 25.2 body/trailer/tick callbacks (CallProxyOnRequestBody + CallProxyOnResponseBody + CallProxyOnRequestTrailers + CallProxyOnResponseTrailers — the root-context callbacks proxy_on_tick + proxy_on_http_call_response + proxy_on_foreign_function dispatch from `*RootVM` directly). At `OnDestroy` the per-stream filter calls `streamCtx.Close(ctx)` which fires `proxy_on_done` + `proxy_on_log` + `proxy_on_delete` + cancels any in-flight httpCalls dispatched from this stream context (cancel-at-destruction per AMEND-B3).

**Per-stream construction cost shrinks from 61µs (25.1) to ~microseconds (25.2).** The 25.1 per-stream cost was dominated by wazero Runtime construction + host-module registration (~50µs) + Module instantiation (~10µs). The 25.2 root-VM model retires Runtime construction + host-module registration (both happen ONCE at NewRootVM); per-stream cost reduces to the `proxy_on_context_create` invocation + the `*StreamContext` bookkeeping (~microseconds expected). The Module instantiation pattern (fresh-per-stream vs pooled vs shared-Module-with-mutex-serialization) is the R8 escape-valve territory at 25.2 IMPL — see "Per-stream Module instantiation R8 escape-valve" below.

**Per-stream Module instantiation R8 escape-valve discipline.** wazero's `wazero.Module` instance is NOT goroutine-safe (concurrent stream callbacks on the same Module instance must be serialized OR each per-stream context gets its own Module instance from the shared CompiledModule). The disposition at SPEC commit: **fresh-per-stream Module instantiation STANDS as WEAK-default** per phase-25.2 SPEC §2.16 + D-25.2-P2. Threshold: `BenchmarkPerStreamModule_Instantiation > 1ms` fires ADR-0209 escape-valve at 25.2 IMPL with the "pooled vs shared-Module-with-mutex-serialization" decision. **Anticipated outcome (low-confidence):** STANDS WEAK-default — the 25.2 root-VM model removes Runtime construction (the bulk of 25.1's per-stream cost); Module instantiation alone is anticipated at ~microseconds. ADR-0209 reserve carries forward to 25.3 if unconsumed.

**Tick goroutine + 10ms envoy-go-strict floor per Q5 + ADR-0186 FIRST co-consumer.** Per `*RootVM` owns ONE dedicated goroutine running `for { select { case <-clock.After(effectivePeriod): rootVM.lockAndCall(proxy_on_tick, rootCtxID); case <-stop: return } }`. `effectivePeriod = max(period_ms, 10ms)` — envoy-go-strict 10ms period floor + envoy-go-strict departure record at 25.2 BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md (consolidated bundle per 25.2 SPEC §13.4 edit #5). Uses ADR-0186 `Clock` seam injection at `NewRootVM(ctx, module, rootCtxID, WithRootClock(clk))` for fixture-0036 fake-time support. **FIRST co-consumer of phase-21 ADR-0186 Clock seam beyond phase-21 itself — RATIFIES the phase-21 Clock-seam extraction discipline.** Goroutine count grows linearly with #PluginConfigs (typically 1-5 in production; up to dozens at multi-plugin-VM-sharing scale at 25.3); not a scalability concern at envoy-go's anticipated deployment scale.

**Shared-data state per Q6 + envoy-go-strict caps (referenced from ADR-0206 for the hostcall surface).** Per-`*RootVM` `sharedDataMap` (Go `map[string]sharedDataEntry`; `sharedDataEntry struct { value []byte; cas uint32 }`; sync.RWMutex). CAS atomic-compare-and-set byte-faithful to cpp-host: `cas=0` unconditionally writes; `cas>0` writes only if existing CAS matches (returns `WasmResult::CasMismatch` (=8) on mismatch). envoy-go-strict cap discipline: per-value 1 MiB cap + 1024-entry cap (both operator-configurable via envoy-go-strict-only `PluginConfig` config fields per 25.2 SPEC §7.4). Cap exceeded returns `WasmResult::InternalFailure` (=10) + `wasm.<plugin>.shared_data_cap_exceeded` envoy-go-strict counter + `envoy_go.failures` counter (per 25.2 SPEC §2.25 scope extension) + integration error log.

**httpCall response routing per Q4 + AMEND-B3.** Per-`*RootVM` `httpCalls map[uint32]*pendingHttpCall` + sync.Mutex. `DispatchHttpCall(ctx, streamCtxID, cluster, headers, body, trailers, timeoutMs)` allocates a monotonic `callID` + records `pendingHttpCall{streamCtxID, deadline}` + invokes phase-20 `internal/httpclient/Client.ClusterDispatch` per the third-or-later co-consumer of ADR-0177 (phase-22.2 was second). Response arrives asynchronously: defensive token-lookup at the AsyncClient callback (`httpCalls[callID]` lookup); if the originating `*StreamContext` has been closed (cancelled per cancel-at-destruction), the lookup misses + `wasm.<plugin>.http_call_response_after_close` envoy-go-strict counter increments per AMEND-B3 (defensive observability for the cancel-race surface). If the lookup hits, the response routes via `streamCtx.OnHttpCallResponse(callID, headers, body, trailers)` which invokes `proxy_on_http_call_response` on the originating context.

**Cancel-at-destruction discipline per AMEND-B3.** At `streamCtx.Close(ctx)` (OnDestroy entry from the filter): iterate `httpCalls` for entries with matching `streamCtxID`; call `httpclient.Cancel(callID)` on each; remove from `httpCalls`. This matches upstream Envoy v1.37.2 `source/extensions/common/wasm/context.cc:1900-1905` destructor byte-faithfully (`for (auto& p : http_request_) { p.second.request_->cancel(); }`). The defensive token-miss guard at response arrival (per AMEND-B3) covers the rare race where envoy-go's Cancel + the response-arrival callback fire concurrently.

**Foreign-function registry view per AMEND-A9.** `*RootVM.foreignReg` points at the per-process `wasm.DefaultForeignFunctionRegistry` by default (EMPTY default registry per AMEND-A9; operators register at boot via `wasm.RegisterForeignFunction(name, fn)`). Testable seam: `WithRootForeignRegistry(reg)` opt-in for fixture-0036 scenario (g) foreign-function-deny-default. The `proxy_call_foreign_function` host shim invokes `*RootVM.CallForeignFunction(ctx, streamCtxID, name, args)` which: (a) RLock the registry + Get the function; (b) on Get-miss return `WasmResult::NotFound` (=1) + `wasm.<plugin>.foreign_function_denied` envoy-go-strict counter increment; (c) on Get-hit execute the function synchronously inside the per-stream call frame (no goroutine offload per D-25.2-P3 anticipated answer); panic-wrapper recovery routes panics to `envoy_go.failures` counter + log.

**Dynamic-stats Registry per Q9 + AMEND-B2.** `*RootVM.dynStats` is a per-`*compiledConfig` `*dynamic.Registry` constructed at `NewRootVM` via `dynamic.NewRegistry(pluginScope, maxEntries)` where `pluginScope` is the per-plugin stat scope (e.g., `stats.RootScope.Subscope("wasm").Subscope(pluginName)`) + `maxEntries = cfg.dynStatsMaxEntries` (envoy-go-strict-only `envoy_go_strict_dynamic_stats_max_entries`; default 1024). The `proxy_define_metric` host shim invokes `*Registry.Register(metricType, name)`; stat names emerge under `pluginScope/wasmcustom.<custom_name>` byte-faithful to upstream per AMEND-B2. The operator sees `wasm.<plugin_name>.wasmcustom.<custom_name>` at admin /stats by virtue of the parent stat-scope nesting; but the in-wire stat name (from the proxy-wasm wire perspective) is `wasmcustom.<custom_name>` byte-faithful to upstream.

**Anticipated `*RootVM` API shape** (provisional at this 25.2 SPEC commit; production signatures land at 25.2 IMPL Task NN; see phase-25.2 SPEC §3.1 for the full signatures):

```go
// internal/wasm/root_vm.go
type RootVM struct { /* unexported; per §3.1 */ }
type RootVMOption func(*RootVM)
func NewRootVM(ctx context.Context, module *Module, rootCtxID uint32, opts ...RootVMOption) (*RootVM, error)
func (rv *RootVM) Configure(ctx context.Context, vmConfigBytes, pluginConfigBytes []byte) error
func (rv *RootVM) NewStreamContext(ctx context.Context) (*StreamContext, error)
func (rv *RootVM) SetTickPeriod(period time.Duration)
func (rv *RootVM) DispatchHttpCall(ctx context.Context, streamCtxID uint32, cluster string, headers []HeaderPair, body []byte, trailers []HeaderPair, timeoutMs uint32) (callID uint32, result WasmResult)
func (rv *RootVM) CallForeignFunction(ctx context.Context, streamCtxID uint32, name string, args []byte) (result []byte, status WasmResult)
func (rv *RootVM) SetSharedData(key string, value []byte, cas uint32) WasmResult
func (rv *RootVM) GetSharedData(key string) (value []byte, cas uint32, status WasmResult)
func (rv *RootVM) Close() error
```

**Anticipated LoC: ~1,200-1,800 LIVE + ~1,500-2,200 TEST** at 25.2 IMPL per the BRAINSTORM §1.4 + 25.2 SPEC §3.5 estimates (substantially larger than 25.1's per-stream `*VM` due to the multi-state aggregation at the root + the tick goroutine + the httpCall routing + the shared-data + the dynamic-stats Registry integration).

### Decision

At 25.2 IMPL the `internal/wasm/` framework primitive EVOLVES to the root-VM lifecycle model per the §Context above:

1. **NEW `internal/wasm/root_vm.go`** materializes the `*RootVM` lifecycle (NewRootVM + Configure + NewStreamContext + Close). One `*RootVM` is constructed per `*compiledConfig` (per-plugin scope; multiple `PluginConfig` entries at the same listener each get their own `*RootVM` at 25.2 — cross-plugin VM-sharing via `vm_id` deferred to 25.3 per parent §3.0). The `*RootVM` owns the wazero Runtime (constructed once at NewRootVM) + the compiled Module (re-compiled against the per-RootVM Runtime via the shared `wazero.CompilationCache`) + the host-module registrations (`registerHostModules(ctx, rv)` invoked once at NewRootVM time; sandbox-gated per AMEND-B5) + the tick goroutine + the shared-data map + the httpCall routing state + the foreign-function registry view + the dynamic-stats Registry + the per-stream-context map.

2. **NEW `internal/wasm/stream_context.go`** materializes `*StreamContext` — the per-stream context that REPLACES the 25.1 per-stream `*VM`. Each per-stream context is allocated via `rootVM.NewStreamContext(ctx)` which: (a) reserves a fresh `streamCtxID` from the monotonic `rv.nextStreamCtxID` counter; (b) invokes `proxy_on_context_create(streamCtxID, rootCtxID)` on the shared Module instance (sandbox-gated per `capProxyOnContextCreate`); (c) returns the `*StreamContext` handle. The handle exposes the same callable methods as 25.1's per-stream `*VM` (CallProxyOnRequestHeaders + CallProxyOnResponseHeaders + …) plus 4 NEW per-stream methods at 25.2 (CallProxyOnRequestBody + CallProxyOnResponseBody + CallProxyOnRequestTrailers + CallProxyOnResponseTrailers). The 3 root-context callbacks (proxy_on_tick + proxy_on_http_call_response + proxy_on_foreign_function) dispatch from `*RootVM` directly (NOT from `*StreamContext`) per the proxy-wasm root-context discipline.

3. **DELETE 25.1's `internal/wasm/vm.go`** per D-P-PLAN-6. The per-stream `*VM` shape is fully retired at 25.2 — no transitional shim. The 25.1 `internal/filter/http/wasm/decode_headers.go` + `encode_headers.go` MIGRATE to consume `rootVM.NewStreamContext` + the per-stream `*StreamContext` returned thereby. The 25.1 `internal/filter/http/wasm/compiled_config.go` MIGRATES to construct the `*RootVM` at `New()` time (NOT per-stream); the per-`*compiledConfig` `*RootVM` is held in `cfg.rootVM` + closed at `cfg.Close()` (which is called at config-resource teardown).

4. **NEW `internal/wasm/tick.go`** materializes the per-RootVM tick goroutine + 10ms envoy-go-strict floor + Clock seam injection. `*RootVM` gains a `clk clock.Clock` field defaulting to `clock.RealClock{}`; the testable seam is `WithRootClock(clk clock.Clock) RootVMOption`. The tick goroutine is started lazily at `SetTickPeriod(period)` (called from the `proxy_set_tick_period_milliseconds` host shim); period=0 stops the goroutine; `effectivePeriod = max(period, 10*time.Millisecond)` enforces the envoy-go-strict floor (silent clamp; no error to guest). **FIRST co-consumer of phase-21 ADR-0186 Clock seam beyond phase-21 itself** — RATIFIES the EXTRACT-NOW-on-second-consumer disposition for ADR-0186 at second-consumer scope (the `internal/clock/` package is EXTRACTED at this Task 5 per D-P-PLAN-7 + the SECOND occurrence of EXTRACT-NOW-on-second-consumer discipline pattern; the phase-21 `internal/filter/http/adaptive_concurrency/clock.go` migration to use the NEW `internal/clock/` package is OUT OF 25.2 scope and noted as a 25.2-follow-up architectural debt).

5. **Per-stream Module instantiation pattern: STANDS WEAK-default fresh-per-stream.** At Task 22 the `BenchmarkPerStreamModule_Instantiation` benchmark measures the per-stream construction cost under the root-VM model: `~98 ns/op` (well under the 1ms R8 threshold per D-P-PLAN-11 + D-25.2-P2). Per the R8 signaling protocol the WEAK-default fresh-per-stream Module instantiation STANDS at 25.2 IMPL phase-done; **ADR-0209 escape-valve STAYS UNCONSUMED** + carries forward to 25.3 IMPL escape-valve slot. 25.3 may re-evaluate against the per-route + multi-plugin VM-sharing surface (which adds per-plugin context isolation + cross-plugin shared-data scoping cost).

6. **Per-RootVM ownership of stats per Task 20 follow-up Concern 2.** The `*RootVM` gains a `stats RootStatsRecorder` interface field defaulting to `noopStatsRecorder{}` if no `WithRootStats(rec)` option was applied. Production wiring at `compiledConfig.New` passes `WithRootStats(cfg.stats)` where `*filterStats` satisfies the `RootStatsRecorder` interface via thin wrappers. This pattern ensures hostcall bodies call `rv.stats.XxxInc()` unconditionally without nil-check guards.

### Consequences

**Positive:**

- **Upstream-byte-faithful per cpp-host `Wasm`/`Plugin` model.** The root-VM lifecycle matches `proxy-wasm-cpp-host:wasm.cc:298-302` + `wasm.cc:181-206` (one root context per plugin; per-stream contexts as children of the root). Operators familiar with upstream Envoy's wasm filter see a structurally-equivalent envoy-go shape.
- **Per-stream cost shrinks from 61µs (25.1) to ~98 ns (25.2; 600× reduction).** The 25.1 per-stream Runtime construction (~50µs host-module registration + ~10µs Module instantiation) is RETIRED at 25.2; per-stream cost is just `proxy_on_context_create` dispatch + `*StreamContext` bookkeeping. This unlocks order-of-magnitude higher throughput for short-lived stream workloads (typical of API-gateway use cases).
- **Tick goroutine + Clock seam at FIRST co-consumer beyond phase-21 RATIFIES ADR-0186.** The phase-21 Clock seam extraction was paid forward at 25.2 with zero API revision; the EXTRACT-NOW-on-second-consumer pattern HOLDS through the second-consumer empirical validation.
- **Shared-data + httpCall routing + foreign-function registry + dynamic-stats Registry consolidated at root scope.** Cross-stream + cross-callback state (shared-data; in-flight httpCall responses) lives at the root context where the cpp-host model places it; per-stream state lives in `*StreamContext`. The separation prevents the "where does state X live" question from surfacing repeatedly at consumer-side bug investigation.
- **NEW `internal/wasm/foreign.go` + `internal/wasm/abi/foreign.go` + `wasm.DefaultForeignFunctionRegistry`** per AMEND-A9 lands the EMPTY-default foreign-function dispatch surface; operators register at boot via `wasm.RegisterForeignFunction(name, fn)`. Per-RootVM override via `WithRootForeignRegistry(reg)` for multi-tenant isolation + fixture-0036 scenario (g) testability.

**Negative / Trade-offs:**

- **Per-`*compiledConfig` `*RootVM` construction at config-load.** The host-module registration + the wazero Runtime construction + the Module re-compile happen at `compiledConfig.New()` rather than per-stream. This shifts the cost from per-stream (high frequency) to per-plugin-config (low frequency; once at boot + once on config reload via xDS). Net: a substantial throughput win at the per-stream hot path.
- **Tick goroutine per `*RootVM`.** One dedicated goroutine per plugin (typically 1-5 in production; up to dozens at multi-plugin-VM-sharing scale at 25.3). At envoy-go's anticipated deployment scale this is not a concern; at the 25.3 multi-plugin sub-phase the goroutine count must stay bounded (a goroutine-leak audit at 25.3 IMPL is implicit).
- **`*RootVM.Close()` ordering discipline.** Tick goroutine must stop BEFORE the wazero Runtime closes (otherwise the tick fires against a torn-down Runtime + panics). Test coverage at `root_vm_test.go::TestClose_CancelsTickGoroutineBeforeRuntime` pins the ordering invariant.
- **Architectural debt: phase-21 not migrated to NEW `internal/clock/`.** Task 5 EXTRACTED the `internal/clock/` package per the EXTRACT-NOW-on-second-consumer discipline; the migration of `internal/filter/http/adaptive_concurrency/clock.go` (which still has inline `defaultClock` + `fakeClock`) to use the NEW package is OUT OF 25.2 scope. Captured as a 25.2-follow-up backlog item in REVIEW.md.

**Forward-pointers:**

- ADR-0206 (25.2 ABI extensions; below) carries the hostcall + callback registration + capability roster + buffer-clamp wire-contract + metric signedness + foreign-function dispatch shape + full property roster decisions.
- ADR-0209 reserve STAYS UNCONSUMED at 25.2 IMPL phase-done; carries forward to 25.3 IMPL escape-valve slot per the R8 signaling protocol.
- 25.3 IMPL re-evaluates the Module instantiation R8 escape-valve against the per-route + multi-plugin VM-sharing surface.

**AMEND (phase-25.3 IMPL Task 15, 2026-05-29).** The 25.2 anchor "ONE long-lived `*RootVM` per `*compiledConfig`" is REFINED at 25.3 to **ONE shared `*RootVM` per `(vm_id, vm_configuration, code)` identity**, shared across all `*compiledConfig` instances with matching identity via the process-global `internal/wasm/registry.go` `*Registry` (`makeVMKey = Sha256(vm_id‖vm_configuration‖code)` + refcount; ADR-0211). A `*compiledConfig` no longer owns its `*RootVM` exclusively: it holds a registry key + a refcount share; `compiledConfig.Close()` Releases the key (refcount--) and the registry closes the underlying `*RootVM` only at refcount 0. Multiple PluginConfigs sharing a `vm_id` (with matching vm_configuration + code) thus share one wazero Runtime + Module + tick goroutine + foreign-function registry; cross-plugin shared-data is shared at the broader raw-`vm_id` scope. The R8 re-evaluation against this multi-plugin surface STANDS WEAK-default at 25.3 IMPL (`BenchmarkPerStreamPluginContextLookup = ~103 ns/op`; `BenchmarkPerStreamModule_Instantiation = ~102 ns/op`; `BenchmarkPerRouteResolve = 0.2 ns/op` — all << 1ms); ADR-0209 + ADR-0213 reserves STAY UNCONSUMED. The tick-goroutine-count concern noted in §Negative is BOUNDED by the sharing: N PluginConfigs sharing one `vm_id`/config/code spawn ONE tick goroutine, not N.

---

## ADR-0206: 25.2 ABI extensions — 14 NEW env-namespace hostcalls (3 body/buffer + 2 stream-control + 1 timer + 4 metrics + 2 shared-data + 1 outbound HTTP + 1 foreign-function) + 7 NEW guest-export callbacks (proxy_on_request_body / proxy_on_response_body / proxy_on_request_trailers / proxy_on_response_trailers / proxy_on_tick / proxy_on_http_call_response / proxy_on_foreign_function) + 21 NEW capability keys at 25.2 with gate-at-registerCallback discipline per AMEND-B5 + buffer-clamp wire-contract per AMEND-B1 + metric signedness per AMEND-B2 + NUL-delimited property-path wire format per AMEND-B4 + `internal/wasm/foreign.go` ForeignFunctionRegistry with EMPTY default registry per AMEND-A9 + full ~70-path proxy_get_property roster per AMEND-B4

**Status:** Accepted; §Context anchored at phase-25.2 SPEC commit; §Decision + §Consequences body landed at phase-25.2 IMPL Tasks 2-13 + ratified at IMPL Task 22 atomic landing per ADR-0044 in-place edit discipline.
**Date:** 2026-05-25 (§Context anchor); 2026-05-26 (§Decision + §Consequences body landed at 25.2 IMPL Task 22).
**Doctrine:** Phase 25.2 §9 family-row sub-phase. ADR-0044 ADR-on-impl convention + §Context-draft discipline + Q10 strict-scope precedent.
**Lands-in:** Phase 25.2 IMPL Tasks that land body/buffer + stream-control + timer + metrics + shared-data + httpCall + foreign-function + property dispatchers (anticipated Tasks 2-10 per the phase-25.2 SPEC §3.5 file split).

### Context

ADR-0206 anchors the **25.2 ABI extensions** per phase-25.2 BRAINSTORM §1.1 + 25.2 SPEC §3.1 + §5. The 25.1 IMPL landed 24 active hostcalls (16 `proxy_*` env-namespace + 8 `wasi_snapshot_preview1.*` shims) + 13 guest-export callbacks; 25.2 ACTIVATES 14 NEW env-namespace hostcalls (lifting 14 of 25.1's 23 stub-Unimplemented entries) + 7 NEW guest-export callbacks. The 8 WASI shims STAY UNCHANGED at 25.2 (no new WASI hostcalls per AMEND-B5). Post-25.2 active surface: 30 env-namespace hostcalls + 8 WASI = 38 hostcalls active; 9 STILL stub-Unimplemented (shared-queue 4 + gRPC 5 — deferred to WASM host family per 25.2 SPEC §2.7 + §2.8).

**14 NEW env-namespace hostcalls at 25.2** (per 25.2 SPEC §5.1 + the BRAINSTORM-anticipated subset):

1. `proxy_get_buffer_bytes(buffer_type, start, max_size, ret_data_ptr, ret_size_ptr) → WasmResult` — body/buffer family; **clamp-on-overflow wire-contract per AMEND-B1** (cpp-host `src/exports.cc:get_buffer_bytes` clamps silently; spec README text saying BAD_ARGUMENT is REFINED here; envoy-go MUST mirror cpp-host clamp behavior for compat with Istio/Envoy production guests). Only `start + max_size` i32-overflow returns BadArgument; the clamp golden table lands at `internal/wasm/abi/body_bridge_test.go` per AMEND-B1.
2. `proxy_set_buffer_bytes(buffer_type, start, size, data_ptr, data_size) → WasmResult` — body/buffer write.
3. `proxy_get_buffer_status(buffer_type, ret_size_ptr, ret_flags_ptr) → WasmResult` — buffer-status query.
4. `proxy_continue_stream(stream_type) → WasmResult` — paired with PAUSE-buffer dispatch on body callbacks; allows guest to resume after returning PAUSE.
5. `proxy_close_stream(stream_type) → WasmResult` — guest-initiated stream close.
6. `proxy_set_tick_period_milliseconds(period_ms) → WasmResult` — timer; **10ms envoy-go-strict period floor** per Q5 (host-side `effectivePeriod = max(period_ms, 10ms)`); lands at `internal/wasm/tick.go` per ADR-0205.
7. `proxy_define_metric(metric_type, name_data, name_size, ret_metric_id_ptr) → WasmResult` — dynamic metric registration; MetricType enum Counter=0/Gauge=1/Histogram=2 per AMEND-B2 + spec README + rust-sdk `src/types.rs`.
8. `proxy_increment_metric(metric_id, delta) → WasmResult` — `delta` is **SIGNED `int64`** per AMEND-B2 (cpp-host `src/exports.cc:1065-1068` + rust-sdk `hostcalls.rs:1395-1397`); allows negative gauge deltas. NOT unsigned as a careless reading would suggest.
9. `proxy_record_metric(metric_id, value) → WasmResult` — `value` is **UNSIGNED `uint64`** per AMEND-B2.
10. `proxy_get_metric(metric_id, ret_value_ptr) → WasmResult` — read current metric value.
11. `proxy_set_shared_data(key_ptr, key_size, value_ptr, value_size, cas) → WasmResult` — CAS-protected K-V write per Q6; envoy-go-strict 1 MiB value cap + 1024-entry cap; CasMismatch on conflict; InternalFailure on cap exceeded. Lands at `internal/wasm/shared_data.go` per ADR-0205.
12. `proxy_get_shared_data(key_ptr, key_size, ret_value_ptr_ptr, ret_value_size_ptr, ret_cas_ptr) → WasmResult` — CAS-aware read.
13. `proxy_http_call(cluster_data, cluster_size, headers_data, headers_size, body_data, body_size, trailers_data, trailers_size, timeout_ms, ret_call_id_ptr) → WasmResult` — 10-arg outbound HTTP per Q4 + AMEND-B3; BadArgument on unknown cluster (Envoy v1.37.2 `context.cc:1547-1550`); cancel-at-destruction discipline per AMEND-B3; `http_call_response_after_close` envoy-go-strict counter for defensive observability per AMEND-B3 recommendation. Lands at `internal/wasm/http_call.go` per ADR-0205.
14. `proxy_call_foreign_function(name_data, name_size, args_data, args_size, ret_results_data_ptr, ret_results_size_ptr) → WasmResult` — foreign-function dispatch per AMEND-A9; EMPTY default registry; unregistered names return `WasmResult::NotFound` (=1) byte-faithful to cpp-host `src/exports.cc:147-184`; `foreign_function_denied` envoy-go-strict counter increment on NotFound. Lands at `internal/wasm/foreign.go` per below.

**7 NEW guest-export callbacks at 25.2** (host invokes these via `wazero.Module.ExportedFunction("proxy_on_X").Call(ctx, args...)`):

- `proxy_on_request_body(stream_context_id, body_size, end_of_stream) → ProxyAction` — per Q1; `body_size` is **accumulated total** (NOT just-new-chunk delta) per spec README + AMEND-B1; per-chunk invocation with PAUSE-buffer semantic if guest returns PAUSE.
- `proxy_on_response_body(stream_context_id, body_size, end_of_stream) → ProxyAction` — symmetric to request.
- `proxy_on_request_trailers(stream_context_id, num_trailers) → ProxyAction` — invoked when trailers arrive on the request side; trailer-map accessors REUSE the 25.1 7-method header-map family with WasmHeaderMapType values 1 (HttpRequestTrailers) + 3 (HttpResponseTrailers) ACTIVATED per AMEND-A7 (defined-but-unused at 25.1).
- `proxy_on_response_trailers(stream_context_id, num_trailers) → ProxyAction` — symmetric to request.
- `proxy_on_tick(root_context_id) → none` — per Q5; invoked by the per-`*RootVM` tick goroutine; sandbox-gated via `proxy_on_tick` capability key per AMEND-B5.
- `proxy_on_http_call_response(plugin_context_id, call_id, num_headers, body_size, num_trailers) → none` — per Q4 + AMEND-B3; invoked when AsyncClient response arrives AND the originating `*StreamContext` is still live; defensive token-miss guard increments `http_call_response_after_close` envoy-go-strict counter on stray responses.
- `proxy_on_foreign_function(context_id, foreign_function_id, data_size) → none` — per AMEND-A9; invoked when a registered foreign function completes (currently never fires because the EMPTY default registry returns NotFound for all `proxy_call_foreign_function` invocations; activates only when operators register host-side foreign functions via `wasm.RegisterForeignFunction`).

**Gate-at-registerCallback discipline per AMEND-B5 — STRUCTURAL REFINEMENT vs AMEND-A5.** Per §11.5 D-25.2-5 empirical scrape against cpp-host `src/wasm.cc:176-189` (`_REGISTER_PROXY` macro): env-namespace hostcalls are gated at `registerCallback` TIME — `if (capabilityAllowed("proxy_" #_fn)) { wasm_vm_->registerCallback("env", "proxy_" #_fn, ...); }`. `exports.cc` contains ZERO `capabilityAllowed` invocations; the gate is enforced by NOT REGISTERING the hostcall on the wasm runtime when the capability is denied. **Implication for envoy-go:** `internal/wasm/registration.go` mirrors cpp-host — for each capability in the 58-key cumulative roster (37 from 25.1 + 21 NEW at 25.2), if the per-`*RootVM` SandboxConfig.IsAllowed(key) returns false, the corresponding host function is NOT registered on the wazero Runtime. The guest's import resolution fails at module-instantiation OR the runtime trap fires on call. This matches upstream byte-faithfully + AMPLIFIES the default-deny posture: a denied hostcall is invisible to the guest from instantiation (not just rejected at runtime).

**21 NEW capability keys at 25.2** (per AMEND-B5 + 25.2 SPEC §5):

- 14 hostcall keys (env namespace): `proxy_get_buffer_bytes`, `proxy_set_buffer_bytes`, `proxy_get_buffer_status`, `proxy_continue_stream`, `proxy_close_stream`, `proxy_set_tick_period_milliseconds`, `proxy_define_metric`, `proxy_increment_metric`, `proxy_record_metric`, `proxy_get_metric`, `proxy_set_shared_data`, `proxy_get_shared_data`, `proxy_http_call`, `proxy_call_foreign_function`.
- 7 lifecycle keys (gated at `getFunction` lookup via `_GET_PROXY` macro per cpp-host `wasm.cc:238-247`): `proxy_on_request_body`, `proxy_on_response_body`, `proxy_on_request_trailers`, `proxy_on_response_trailers`, `proxy_on_tick`, `proxy_on_http_call_response`, `proxy_on_foreign_function`.

Post-25.2 cumulative roster: 37 (25.1) + 21 (NEW) = **58 keys**.

**`internal/wasm/foreign.go` NEW file per AMEND-A9.** `ForeignFunctionRegistry` (Register / Get; sync.RWMutex + `map[string]ForeignFunctionFn`) with EMPTY default registry. The `proxy_call_foreign_function` host shim returns `WasmResult::NotFound` (=1) for unregistered names byte-faithful to upstream cpp-host `src/exports.cc:147-184`. Capability-gated via default-deny `proxy_call_foreign_function` capability key per AMEND-A5 + AMEND-B5 gate-at-registration. **envoy-go-strict departure record #4 at 25.2 BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT.md**: upstream registers 10 foreign functions by default (`verify_signature`, `sign`, `compress`, `uncompress`, `set_envoy_filter_state`, `clear_route_cache`, `expr_create`, `expr_evaluate`, `expr_delete`, `declare_property`); envoy-go registers ZERO. Operators MUST explicitly enable the `proxy_call_foreign_function` capability AND register specific foreign functions at multi-consumer scope via `wasm.RegisterForeignFunction(name, fn)` at boot.

**Foreign-function dispatch concurrency model per D-25.2-P3 (anticipated answer; settles at PLAN).** Mutex-per-`*RootVM` (sync.RWMutex on the Registry + the dispatched function executes synchronously inside `*RootVM.CallForeignFunction` in the per-stream call frame). No goroutine offload at 25.2 — the function's compute cost is the operator's responsibility. Panic-recovery wrapper discipline matches other host-side callbacks (panic → recover → `envoy_go.failures` counter + log). The registry Get path holds an RLock only (read-only access during dispatch).

**Full proxy_get_property roster + NUL-delimited path serialization per AMEND-B4.** Per §11.4 D-25.2-4 empirical scrape against `envoyproxy/envoy@v1.37.2:source/extensions/filters/common/expr/context.h` + `source/extensions/common/wasm/context.cc:1040-1115`. Path serialization is **NUL-delimited byte segments** (e.g., `["foo","bar"]` → `0x66 0x6f 0x6f 0x00 0x62 0x61 0x72`) per spec README §Serialization + context.cc:1047-1058 host-parsing. Roster: **~10 dispatched roots + 4 direct tokens; ~70 documented sub-paths**:

- `request` (16 sub-paths): path, url_path, host, scheme, method, referer, headers, headers_bytes, time, id, useragent, size, total_size, duration, protocol, query.
- `response` (6 sub-paths): code, code_details, trailers, flags, grpc_status, backend_latency.
- `connection` (12+id sub-paths): mtls, requested_server_name, tls_version, termination_details, subject_local_certificate, subject_peer_certificate, uri_san_local_certificate, uri_san_peer_certificate, dns_san_local_certificate, dns_san_peer_certificate, sha256_peer_certificate_digest, transport_failure_reason, id.
- `source` (2 sub-paths): address, port.
- `destination` (2 sub-paths): address, port.
- `upstream` (~14 sub-paths): address, port, local_address, locality, transport_failure_reason, request_attempt_count, cx_pool_ready_duration, num_endpoints + TLS cert sub-symbols.
- `xds` (12 sub-paths — CONSOLIDATES listener+route+cluster metadata): cluster_name, cluster_metadata, route_name, route_metadata, virtual_host_name, virtual_host_metadata, upstream_host_metadata, upstream_host_locality_metadata, filter_chain_name, listener_metadata, listener_direction, node.
- `metadata` (filter-name keyed; google.protobuf.Struct).
- `filter_state` (key-keyed; FilterStateObject).
- `upstream_filter_state` (key-keyed; upstream-scoped FilterStateObject) — **DISTINCT root co-equal to `filter_state`** per AMEND-B4 REFINEMENT (BRAINSTORM Q7 OMITTED this).
- `wasm.<key>` (special; proxied to filter_state then upstream filter_state).
- Direct tokens (4): `plugin_name`, `plugin_root_id`, `plugin_vm_id`, `connection_id`.

**No standalone `listener.*`/`route.*`/`downstream.*` roots** — folded into `xds.*` + `connection.*` + `source.*` per AMEND-B4. **No `wasm` root for self-introspection** beyond the `wasm.<filter_state_key>` proxy.

**Absent-property behavior:** `WasmResult::NotFound` (=1) per context.cc:1065/1072/1078/1083/1103/1106/1110.

**envoy-go-internal primitive mapping for the property roster:**
- `request.*`, `response.*`, `source.*`, `destination.*` → stream-local accessors (no co-consumed primitive needed).
- `connection.{subject,uri_san,dns_san,sha256,tls_version}_*` → RE-CONSUMES phase-04 ADR-0144 `DownstreamPrincipal()`.
- `upstream.{cluster fields via xds.cluster_*}`, `upstream.address/port/local_address` → RE-CONSUMES phase-20 ADR-0177 `internal/httpclient/`.
- `metadata.*`, `xds.*_metadata` → RE-CONSUMES phase-22.2 ADR-0190 `internal/dynamicmetadata/`.
- `filter_state.*`, `upstream_filter_state.*`, `wasm.<key>` → EXTRACTS NEW `internal/filterstate/` framework primitive per Q7 + ADR-0207.
- Direct tokens (`plugin_name`, `plugin_root_id`, `plugin_vm_id`, `connection_id`) → wasm-VM-local, no primitive.

**Lands at `internal/wasm/property.go`** (per 25.2 SPEC §3.5) with full per-root dispatch + NUL-delimited path parsing + co-consumed primitive integration. Test coverage at `internal/wasm/property_test.go` covers the ~70 sub-paths via table-driven tests.

**WasmBufferType values activated at 25.2:** values 0 (HttpRequestBody) + 1 (HttpResponseBody) + 4 (HttpCallResponseBody) per AMEND-A7 — defined-but-unused at 25.1; ACTIVATED via the body+buffer hostcall registrations.

**WasmHeaderMapType values activated at 25.2:** values 1 (HttpRequestTrailers) + 3 (HttpResponseTrailers) per AMEND-A7 — defined-but-unused at 25.1; ACTIVATED via the trailer callback registrations + the 25.1 header-map family REUSE.

**Cross-references:** ADR-0202 (paired primitive-side ADR — `internal/wasm/`; gains one-line in-place AMEND acknowledgment paragraph in §Consequences per 25.2 SPEC §10.2 at 25.2 IMPL); ADR-0205 (paired root-VM lifecycle ADR — co-anchors the per-`*RootVM` infrastructure that this 25.2 ABI extension exercises); ADR-0207 (paired `internal/filterstate/` extraction — co-anchors the `filter_state.*` + `upstream_filter_state.*` property paths per AMEND-B4); ADR-0208 (paired filter-package extension ADR — co-anchors the filter-side consumer integration + the 9 envoy-go-strict counters per AMEND-B3); phase-25.2 SPEC §3.1 + §3.5 + §5 + §11 D-25.2-1 + D-25.2-2 + D-25.2-3 + D-25.2-4 + D-25.2-5; ADR-0144 + ADR-0177 + ADR-0190 (RE-CONSUMED at consumer scope for the property roster); ADR-0188 (`internal/lua/` precedent for the gate-at-registration discipline — phase-22 lua's `SandboxConfig` is gate-at-call-site, distinct from cpp-host's gate-at-registration which 25.2 wasm adopts per AMEND-B5).

### Decision

At 25.2 IMPL the `internal/wasm/` framework primitive EXTENDS with the 14 NEW env-namespace hostcalls + 7 NEW guest-export callbacks + 21 NEW capability keys per the §Context above. Concrete landings:

1. **`internal/wasm/sandbox.go` EXTEND** at Task 2 — 21 NEW capability key constants for the 25.2 surface (14 hostcall capabilities + 7 callback capabilities). Cumulative roster: 37 keys (25.1) + 21 NEW (25.2) = 58 keys; the broader §9 WASM host family roster anticipated at ~80 keys by 25.3 phase-done.

2. **`internal/wasm/registration.go` EXTEND** at Task 3 — host-module wiring for the 14 NEW env-namespace hostcalls (gate-at-`registerCallback` per AMEND-B5 STRUCTURAL REFINEMENT — denied capabilities are NOT registered on the wazero Runtime; the guest's import resolution FAILS at module-instantiation time, OR (if the guest defensively no-imports the denied function) the runtime trap fires on first call). Each registered hostcall wraps the underlying `abi.XxxShim(ctx, mod, vm, ...)` dispatch via `vm.runWithPanicWrapper` for panic-to-`envoy_go.failures` routing. The 7 NEW guest-export callback wiring uses the same `_GET_PROXY` discipline as 25.1's lifecycle callbacks (`vm.sandbox.IsAllowed(<key>)` controls export lookup).

3. **`internal/wasm/abi/body_bridge.go` + `internal/wasm/abi/stream_control.go`** NEW at Task 4 — buffer-clamp wire-contract per AMEND-B1 (`proxy_get_buffer_bytes` clamps on overflow byte-faithful to cpp-host: `if start > buffer.size → length=0 + Ok`; `if start+length > buffer.size → length = buffer.size - start + Ok`; only `start+length i32-overflow` returns `BadArgument`) + stream-control dispatch (`proxy_continue_stream` + `proxy_close_stream` against `WasmStreamType` values 0/1).

4. **`internal/wasm/tick.go` + `internal/wasm/abi/timer.go`** NEW at Task 5 — per-RootVM tick goroutine + 10ms envoy-go-strict period floor + Clock seam FIRST co-consumer (see ADR-0205 §Decision point 4). Tick hostcall (`proxy_set_tick_period_milliseconds`) + tick callback (`proxy_on_tick`).

5. **`internal/wasm/shared_data.go` + `internal/wasm/abi/shared_data.go`** NEW at Task 6 — CAS-protected K-V map per Q6 + envoy-go-strict caps. CAS semantics: `cas=0` always writes; `cas>0` writes only on match (returns `WasmResult::CasMismatch` (=8) on mismatch). Cap-exceeded → `WasmResult::InternalFailure` + `shared_data_cap_exceeded` counter + `envoy_go.failures` counter.

6. **`internal/wasm/foreign.go` + `internal/wasm/abi/foreign.go`** NEW at Task 7 — ForeignFunctionRegistry with EMPTY default registry per AMEND-A9. `wasm.DefaultForeignFunctionRegistry` process-global + `wasm.RegisterForeignFunction(name, fn)` + per-`*RootVM` override via `WithRootForeignRegistry(reg)`. Unregistered names → `WasmResult::NotFound` (=1) + `foreign_function_denied` counter. Concurrent dispatch model: mutex-per-RootVM serialization per D-25.2-P3 + D-P-PLAN-9 (verified at Task 7 with concurrent N=100 dispatch + no cross-stream argument leak); registered functions execute synchronously inside the per-stream call frame (NOT root-context, NOT goroutine-offloaded).

7. **`internal/wasm/http_call.go` + `internal/wasm/abi/http_call.go`** NEW at Task 8 — `proxy_http_call` dispatch + cancel-at-destruction discipline per AMEND-B3. RE-CONSUMES phase-20 `internal/httpclient/` via the per-RootVM `HTTPDispatcher` interface (third-or-later co-consumer of ADR-0177 per the phase-25.2 SPEC mapping). Defensive `http_call_response_after_close` counter (AMEND-B3 RAISES BRAINSTORM Q9 8 → 9) increments if a stray response slips past the cancel guard.

8. **`internal/wasm/dynamic_stats.go` + `internal/wasm/abi/metrics.go`** NEW at Task 12 — metric hostcall dispatch (proxy_define_metric / proxy_increment_metric / proxy_record_metric / proxy_get_metric). Signed-int64 delta per AMEND-B2 (negative offsets supported for Gauge); unsigned-uint64 record value. Wraps per-plugin `*dynamic.Registry` from NEW `internal/stats/dynamic/` infrastructure subpackage (ADR-0208).

9. **`internal/wasm/property.go` EXTEND** at Task 13 — full ~70-path proxy_get_property roster per AMEND-B4. 10 dispatched roots + 4 direct tokens; NUL-delimited path parsing; co-consumed primitive integration (DownstreamPrincipal ADR-0144 + httpclient ADR-0177 + dynamicmetadata ADR-0190 + NEW filterstate ADR-0207); `xds.*` CONSOLIDATES listener+route+cluster per AMEND-B4 SUBSTANTIVE REFINEMENT (vs BRAINSTORM Q7's ~25-path hypothesis — the actual roster is ~10 dispatched roots + 4 direct tokens reaching ~70 sub-paths).

### Consequences

**Positive:**

- **Full advanced-bridge surface ACTIVATED at 25.2.** All BRAINSTORM-anticipated hostcalls + callbacks land; operator-authored `.wasm` plugins at 25.2 IMPL phase-done can invoke any hostcall from the 38-hostcall active surface (gated by the default-deny capability sandbox per AMEND-A5 + the gate-at-registration discipline per AMEND-B5). The previously-stub-Unimplemented 14 hostcalls from 25.1 are RETIRED.
- **Buffer-clamp wire-contract per AMEND-B1 + cpp-host empirical evidence at §11.1 D-25.2-1.** The 25.2 SPEC pin to the cpp-host clamp behavior (vs. the v0.2.1 spec README text saying `BAD_ARGUMENT`) prevents subtle guest incompat with real-world Istio/Envoy wasm plugins that rely on the clamp.
- **Metric signedness per AMEND-B2 + cpp-host empirical evidence at §11.2 D-25.2-2.** `proxy_increment_metric` accepts signed-int64 deltas (supports negative Gauge deltas); `proxy_record_metric` accepts unsigned-uint64 absolute values. Golden table at `internal/wasm/abi/metrics_test.go` pins the byte-stable wire shape.
- **Foreign-function 0-vs-10 default registry per AMEND-A9 + mutex-per-RootVM concurrency per D-25.2-P3.** The EMPTY default registry posture is safe-by-default (operators opt-in per function); the mutex-per-RootVM concurrency model is simple + correct (the alternative of goroutine-per-call would surface ordering questions + per-call context-propagation cost).
- **Full ~70-path property roster per AMEND-B4 + cpp-host + envoy v1.37.2 empirical evidence at §11.4 D-25.2-4.** The roster matches upstream Envoy's `source/extensions/filters/common/expr/context.h` property tree at 25.2; co-consumed primitives (DownstreamPrincipal + httpclient + dynamicmetadata + filterstate) anchor consistent per-segment dispatch.
- **Gate-at-`registerCallback` discipline per AMEND-B5 + cpp-host empirical evidence at §11.5 D-25.2-5.** STRUCTURAL REFINEMENT vs phase-22.2 lua's gate-at-call-site discipline (ADR-0188): wasm's gate-at-registration mirrors cpp-host's `wasm.cc:181-206` `_GET_PROXY` macro byte-faithfully; denied capabilities are NOT registered (the guest's import resolution fails at module-instantiation, OR the runtime trap fires on first call if the guest defensively no-imports the denied function).

**Negative / Trade-offs:**

- **Gate-at-registration breaks Rust SDK auto-imports for cap-restricted fixtures.** The proxy-wasm-rust-sdk v0.2.4 auto-imports ALL proxy-wasm hostcalls regardless of guest usage; denying a cap means the host doesn't register the function, which breaks guest module instantiation. Fixture-0034 (which has a restricted cap-set at 25.1 because the 25.2 hostcalls were stubs) required cap-set widening at Task 22 fix-up to accommodate the gate-at-registration discipline. Documented as a 25.2-follow-up departure note in REVIEW.md.
- **mutex-per-RootVM foreign-function concurrency serializes calls.** A guest dispatching `proxy_call_foreign_function` from N concurrent streams serializes through the per-RootVM registry mutex. At envoy-go's anticipated deployment scale (modest foreign-function dispatch rate vs. headers/body) this is not a hot path; if surfaces at 25.3 multi-plugin scale, can be refactored to per-key sharding without API revision.
- **Full ~70-path property roster expands the consumer-side dispatch surface considerably.** Test coverage at `internal/wasm/property_test.go` is correspondingly extensive (~70 table-driven test rows per AMEND-B4); the per-segment dispatch is now the largest single file in `internal/wasm/`.

**Forward-pointers:**

- ADR-0207 (NEW `internal/filterstate/`) anchors the `filter_state.*` + `upstream_filter_state.*` property paths.
- ADR-0208 (NEW `internal/filter/http/wasm/` 25.2 package extensions) anchors the filter-side consumer integration + the 9 envoy-go-strict counters + the 4 envoy-go-strict-only config fields.
- 25.3 may extend the property roster with the per-route `xds.*` family + multi-plugin `vm_id`-keyed sharing surface.
